cases.title: Toggle Text Box Visibility Normal and Boundary State
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button') makes the text box (data-testid='text-box') appear by adding the 'show' class, and subsequent clicks correctly hide it, ensuring the final state reflects the last user action.

cases.title: Rapid Repeated Clicks on Toggle Button
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button') are handled reliably without inconsistent UI states, ensuring the final visibility state of the text box (data-testid='text-box') correctly matches the expected outcome of the final click.

cases.title: Close visible text box using close button
cases.description: Verify that when the text box (data-testid='text-box') is visible with the 'show' class, clicking the 'Close' button (data-testid='close-button') hides the text box by removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Rapid toggle and immediate close interaction
cases.description: Verify that when a user opens the text box using the toggle button and immediately clicks the close button (data-testid='close-button'), the text box is successfully hidden and remains in the closed state.

cases.title: Populate voice dropdown on text box open
cases.description: Verify that when the user clicks the toggle button (data-testid='toggle-button') to make the text box visible, the system invokes getVoices and populates the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') with available Web Speech API voices.

cases.title: Dynamic update of voices via voiceschanged event
cases.description: Verify that the system listens for the 'voiceschanged' event and dynamically updates the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') when available voices change after the text box is opened.

cases.title: Select a voice with specific language code
cases.description: Verify that the user can select a voice option containing a specific language code such as 'US' or 'CN' from the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') and that the system accurately assigns the chosen voice to the active speech synthesis message.

cases.title: Multiple sequential voice selections
cases.description: Verify that when a user makes multiple sequential voice selections from data-testid='voice-select', the system correctly updates and ensures the last selected voice is set as the active voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Read Entered Text Aloud Using Selected Voice
cases.description: Verify that when the user toggles the text box via data-testid='toggle-button', enters text into data-testid='text-area', selects a voice from data-testid='voice-select', and clicks the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button'), the system successfully invokes speech synthesis to read the entered text aloud using the chosen voice.

cases.title: Handle Reading with Boundary and Edge Input Conditions
cases.description: Verify system behavior when the user attempts to click the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button') immediately after opening the text box, handling edge conditions such as empty text fields or very long text strings gracefully without throwing unhandled exceptions.

cases.title: Click Predefined Phrase Box for Speech Playback and Visual Highlight
cases.description: Verify that clicking a predefined phrase box in the main section reads the associated text aloud using the Web Speech API and visually highlights the box by adding the active class for exactly 800 milliseconds.

cases.title: Rapid Repeated and Sequential Clicks on Phrase Boxes
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the same phrase box and sequential clicks across different boxes correctly trigger speech playback and manage the active class visual feedback without state inconsistency.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases comprehensively and accurately cover the requirements without any noticeable blockers, contradictions, or untestable assertions.
All test cases are well-structured, appropriately cover all specified requirements (R-1 through R-6), and correctly validate both normal and boundary conditions.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-1: Normal scenario - Click toggle button (data-testid=toggle-button) to show text box (data-testid=text-box) by adding 'show' class. Edge scenario - Rapid repeated clicks on the toggle button. Boundary scenario - Verify final state matches last user action. Abnormal scenario - None identified. Actionable missing scenarios - Rapid double/triple click state synchronization. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-2: Normal scenario - Click close button (data-testid=close-button) inside the visible text box to remove 'show' class. Edge scenario - Opening and immediately closing the text box. Boundary scenario - Repeated toggling followed by close. Abnormal scenario - None. Actionable missing scenarios - Verification of 'show' class removal upon clicking data-testid=close-button. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-3: Normal scenario - Open text box to trigger getVoices() and populate dropdown (data-testid=voice-select). Edge scenario - Handle 'voiceschanged' event dynamically updating the options. Boundary scenario - Empty voice list initially. Abnormal scenario - Web Speech API unavailable or returning no voices. Actionable missing scenarios - Dropdown population upon opening and handling 'voiceschanged' event. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-4: Normal scenario - Select a voice from data-testid=voice-select to assign to message.voice. Edge scenario - Multiple sequential voice selections ensuring last selected voice is active. Boundary scenario - Voice options containing language codes like 'CN' or 'US'. Abnormal scenario - Selecting non-existent voice option. Actionable missing scenarios - Verification of language codes ('CN', 'US') filtering and assignment. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-5: Normal scenario - Enter text in data-testid=text-area, select voice, and click 'Read Text' (data-testid=read-button). Edge scenario - Reading empty or extremely long text. Boundary scenario - Clicking read button immediately after toggling text box. Abnormal scenario - Speech synthesis failure or unsupported configuration. Actionable missing scenarios - End-to-end text reading flow via data-testid=read-button. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-6: Normal scenario - Click predefined phrase box in main section to read text and add active class for 800ms. Edge scenario - Rapid sequential clicks across different boxes or rapid repeated clicks on the same box. Boundary scenario - Active class removal precisely after 800ms. Abnormal scenario - Missing image or paragraph data. Actionable missing scenarios - 800ms active class timeout verification and sequential phrase box clicks.
